briefs.task:
Bring Thrum's plans into the orchestrate 1.7.0 shape after the migration to docs/plans (commit 42fdce97). Your first landing will be refused until the oversized plans are trimmed; that is intended, so trim and land again. Done when:
- ARCHITECTURE.md opens with the module table (# | Module | What it's for | Needs), in plain words, with no status column, and the status column and status prose elsewhere in it are gone.
- Every milestone is named for what someone can see or do.
- Done milestones are a heading plus a link to their review.
- Review briefs (about 400 lines, ATMOSPHERE's plan especially) and pasted handoffs are moved to docs/evidence/<MODULE>/.
- Design sections are moved out of plans into DESIGN.md, such as PLATFORM-RUNTIME-IOS's 'Shell design'.
- The per-module *-BRIEF.md files are folded into their module folders.
- docs/BUILD-PLAN.md is folded into BRIEF.md, with Purpose: pointing at it.
- The stray plans docs/design/CONSTRUCTION-PLAN.md, docs/design/decisions/G7-SHOWCASE-ROUTE-PLAN.md and docs/evidence/i2a/SOURCE-SPACE-PLAN.md are converted or deleted.
- The status prose is removed from ORCHESTRATE.md's Targets section.
Don't change any done-when item, record file or milestone scope; this is a reshape, not a replan. Fix links that the moves break.
